reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that provides a floating chat HUD with live transcripts, session controls, agent messaging, and optional Picture-in-Picture detachment.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可拖拽的悬浮聊天 HUD，用于查看实时会话、发送消息、切换会话与模型，并可分离为画中画窗口。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a draggable floating chat HUD for live transcripts, messaging, session and model controls, and optional Picture-in-Picture detachment.

capabilities: Displays live session transcripts with markdown rendering
Sends user messages to the active agent session
Switches workspace, session, model, and reasoning-effort selections
Provides an in-page draggable HUD and Chrome/Edge Picture-in-Picture window
